esbuild.reason: drives a native platform binary through child_process and an ESM binary loader; the npm package has no in-browser build
esbuild.remediation: esbuild-wasm is registered as a curated WASM tool (#149): single-file transform via the JS API, stdin/file input, --version; bundling flags remain unsupported

argon2.reason: native .node addon built with node-gyp; argon2 itself ships no browser or WASM build
argon2.remediation: the default nativeAddonLoader maps argon2's .node require to argon2-wasm@0.9.0 (#149); packages should prefer argon2-wasm directly for full API coverage

bcrypt.reason: native .node addon via node-pre-gyp; bcrypt ships no WASM or browser build
bcrypt.remediation: the default nativeAddonLoader maps bcrypt's .node require to bcryptjs (pure JS, API-compatible) (#149); packages should prefer bcryptjs directly

lightningcss.reason: loads a native .node binding through per-platform optional dependencies; no WASM fallback ships in this package
lightningcss.remediation: the default nativeAddonLoader maps lightningcss's .node require to lightningcss-wasm (napi-wasm) (#149); packages should prefer lightningcss-wasm directly for full API coverage

rspack.reason: @rspack/core requires its native Rust binding (@rspack/binding-*, a .node addon) via dynamic require; the browser build is a separate package
rspack.remediation: use @rspack/browser; @rspack/core itself has no WASM path

turbo.reason: turbo is a wrapper around a native Rust binary; there is no browser-compatible build
turbo.remediation: none; keep turbo on Node, no WASM or browser story exists
